# watchpoint_usage_budget (Resource)

A usage budget that fires a notification when projected or actual spend crosses a cents threshold. Independent of overage hard-caps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_usage_budget" "example" {
  name            = "Warn at $50 overage"
  threshold_cents = 5000
  mode            = "forecast"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable budget name.
- `threshold_cents` (Number) Spend threshold in cents. Must be positive.

### Optional

- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `mode` (String) Budget evaluation mode: `forecast` (projected) or `actual`. Defaults to `forecast`.
- `notify_email` (String) Email address notified when the budget is breached.
- `product_slug` (String) Optional product slug to scope the budget to a single product. Omit for an all-products budget.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Usage budget ID.
- `last_breached_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent breach (RFC 3339), if any.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_usage_budget.example budget_001
```
